'''Wing 4''' was the callsign of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic troop carrier|Rocket-jumper troopship]] that served during the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]].

==History==
Wing 4 delievered [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|Republic rocket-jumpers]] to the battlefield on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in [[3998 BBY]], when the Republic sent a fleet of ships to aid the besieged [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] task force there.

Its rocket-troopers came down in the same area as the ''[[Krath Enchanter]]''.
